'''Katrin Suder''' (born 29 September 1971) is a German physicist and management consultant who served as [[Secretary of state|State Secretary]] in the [[Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)|Federal Ministry of Defense]] in the government of [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] from 2014 to 2018.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Katrin Suder|url=https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/themen/digitalisierung/katrin-suder-1505708|access-date=2021-10-13|website=Bundesregierung|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Bundesministerium der Verteidigung|url=https://www.bmvg.de/de|access-date=2021-10-13|website=www.bmvg.de|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Von der Leyens Vertraute: Staatssekretärin Suder verlässt Verteidigungsministerium|language=de|work=FAZ.NET|url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/inland/katrin-suder-verlaesst-das-verteidigungsministerium-15490770.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=0174-4909}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Suder was born in Mainz on 29 September 1971.<ref name=":0" /> She studied physics at [[RWTH Aachen]]. In 2000, she received her doctorate in neuroinformatics at the [[Ruhr University Bochum]]. Suder also received a bachelor's degree in theater and linguistics there. She was a scholarship holder of the [[German National Academic Foundation]].

==Career==
===McKinsey, 2000–2014===
From 2000, Suder worked for the management consultancy [[McKinsey]] and in 2007 took over the company's Berlin office.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Naturwissenschaftler bei McKinsey {{!}} e-fellows.net|url=https://www.e-fellows.net/Karriere/Unsere-Partnerunternehmen/McKinsey/Naturwissenschaftler|access-date=2021-10-13|website=www.e-fellows.net}}</ref> She made a career as a consultant for the German and international IT industry and became a director at McKinsey in 2010, where she dealt with diversity management, among other things.<ref name="managermag">{{cite web |author=Dietmar Student |url=http://ml.managermagazin.de/article.do?id=951828&pgc=5 |title=Berater im Überlebenskampf – McKinsey gegen den Rest der Welt |website=ml.managermagazin.de |archive-url=https://archive.today/20140524013645/http://ml.managermagazin.de/article.do?id=951828&pgc=5 |archive-date=2014-05-24|url-status=dead |access-date=2015-12-28}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.queer.de/detail.php?article_id=21646|title=Lesbische Frau wird von der Leyens Staatssekretärin|website=queer.de|date=26 May 2014}}</ref> 

From 2009 to 2014 Suder was responsible for the company's activities in the public sector. Suder worked for several years as a manager at the interface between administration and the private sector, leading reform projects for the [[Federal Employment Agency]] and developing a concept for improving the start-up culture for the State of Berlin.<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Gebauer|first1=Matthias|last2=Repinski|first2=Gordon|last3=Traufetter|first3=Gerald|date=2014-05-23|title=Verteidigungsministerium: Von der Leyen holt McKinsey-Beraterin|language=de|work=Der Spiegel|url=https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/verteidigungsministerium-von-der-leyen-holt-mckinsey-beraterin-a-971397.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=2195-1349}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Visser|first=Corinna|date=2013-10-08|title=Berlin soll spitze werden|language=de-DE|work=Der Tagesspiegel Online|url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/wirtschaft/wowereit-und-start-ups-berlin-soll-spitze-werden/8898692.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=1865-2263}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Katrin Suder, Author at The European|url=https://www.theeuropean.de/katrin-suder/|access-date=2021-10-13|website=www.theeuropean.de}}</ref> At McKinsey, she campaigned for an open-minded approach to different sexual orientations (LGBT diversity management).<ref>{{Cite web|title=ZEIT ONLINE {{!}} Lesen Sie zeit.de mit Werbung oder im PUR-Abo. Sie haben die Wahl.|url=https://www.zeit.de/zustimmung?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.zeit.de%2F2015%2F10%2Fkatrin-suder-bundeswehr|access-date=2021-10-13|website=www.zeit.de}}</ref>

===Federal Ministry of Defense, 2014–2018===
Suder was sworn in on 1 August 2014 as a permanent state secretary in the Federal Ministry of Defense with the task of reforming the armaments sector. She thus succeeded {{Ill|Stéphane Beemelmans|de}}, who was put into temporary retirement in February 2014.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Hickmann|first=Christoph|title=Von der Leyen plant Aufrüstung|url=https://www.sueddeutsche.de/politik/posten-im-verteidiungsministerium-von-der-leyen-plant-aufruestung-1.1974147|access-date=2021-10-13|website=Süddeutsche.de|language=de}}</ref>

The departments '' Equipment '' and '' Cyber / Information Technology '' were directly subordinated to her; it was also responsible for matters relating to the Planning Department.<ref name="Serenade für Katrin Suder">{{Cite web|title=Serenade für Katrin Suder|url=https://www.bmvg.de/de/aktuelles/serenade-fuer-katrin-suder-24430|access-date=2021-10-13|website=www.bmvg.de|language=de|archive-date=2018-12-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181213124810/https://www.bmvg.de/de/aktuelles/serenade-fuer-katrin-suder-24430|url-status=dead}}</ref> During her time in office, she oversaw a series of changes in procurement processes aimed at making the process more transparent and insulating the German government from further cost overruns such as those seen on the [[A400M]].<ref>Andrea Shalal (12 March 2018), [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-germany-military-suder-idAFKCN1GO2A5 Top procurement official quits German defence ministry] ''[[Reuters]]''.</ref>

With her, Gundbert Scherf moved from McKinsey to the Federal Ministry of Defense in September 2014. He temporarily stood in for her during her baby break, but left the ministry two years later.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-11-30|title=Gundbert Scherf, der Umrüster|url=https://www.capital.de/wirtschaft-politik/management-gundbert-scherf-mckinsey-bundeswehr-portraet-junge-elite-8214|access-date=2021-10-13|website=Capital.de|language=de-DE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last1=Gebauer|first1=Matthias|last2=Traufetter|first2=Gerald|date=2016-09-13|title=Ursula von der Leyens Rüstungsberater geht zu McKinsey|language=de|work=Der Spiegel|url=https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/ursula-von-der-leyens-ruestungsberater-geht-zu-mckinsey-a-1112078.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=2195-1349}}</ref>

Suder was sanctioned and banned from entering the country by [[Russia]] in May 2015. Her name was on a list of 89 EU politicians; according to Russian sources, the ban was a reaction to sanctions against Russia.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2015-05-31|title=Einreise-Verbote: Russland wirft EU-Politikern Show-Gehabe vor|language=de|work=Der Spiegel|url=https://www.spiegel.de/politik/ausland/einreise-verbote-russland-wirft-eu-politikern-show-gehabe-vor-a-1036419.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=2195-1349}}</ref><ref name="yle-liste">{{cite web |author=RUS |url=http://www.yle.fi/tvuutiset/uutiset/upics/liitetiedostot/RUS_Einreiseverbotsliste.pdf |title=Russische Visasperrliste |website=www.yle.fi |date=2015-05-26 |format=PDF 23&nbsp;kB |access-date=2015-06-01}}</ref>

From 11 to 14 June 2015, Suder took part in the 63rd Bilderberg Conference in [[Telfs]]-Buchen, [[Austria]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2015-06-23|title=Participants {{!}} Bilderberg Meetings|url=http://www.bilderbergmeetings.org/participants2015.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150623005615/http://www.bilderbergmeetings.org/participants2015.html|archive-date=2015-06-23|access-date=2021-10-13}}</ref>

At her own request, Suder resigned from the office of State Secretary in April 2018.<ref name="Serenade für Katrin Suder"/><ref>{{Cite web|title=Ursula von der Leyen im Netzwerk der Berater|url=https://www.haz.de/Nachrichten/Politik/Deutschland-Welt/Ursula-von-der-Leyen-im-Netzwerk-der-Berater|access-date=2021-10-13|website=HAZ – Hannoversche Allgemeine|language=de|archive-date=2021-10-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026212103/https://www.haz.de/Nachrichten/Politik/Deutschland-Welt/Ursula-von-der-Leyen-im-Netzwerk-der-Berater|url-status=dead}}</ref> As a farewell, Minister [[Ursula von der Leyen]] awarded her the Bundeswehr Cross of Honor in gold.<ref name="Serenade für Katrin Suder"/> 

===Later career===
In August 2018, Suder took over the chairmanship of the newly founded ten-member digital council of the German federal government.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2018-08-21|title=Katrin Suder wird Digitalrats-Vorsitzende|language=de|work=Der Spiegel|url=https://www.spiegel.de/netzwelt/netzpolitik/katrin-suder-wird-digitalrats-vorsitzende-a-1224265.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=2195-1349}}</ref> In May 2021, she was nominated to head the newly created IT department on the Board of Management of [[Volkswagen]],<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Friese|first1=Ulrich|last2=Germis|first2=Carsten|last3=Neuscheler|first3=Tillmann|title=Katrin Suder: Eine Rüstungsexpertin für den VW-Vorstand|language=de|work=FAZ.NET|url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/wirtschaft/unternehmen/katrin-suder-eine-ruestungsexpertin-fuer-den-vw-vorstand-17307114.html|access-date=2021-10-13|issn=0174-4909}}</ref> but was rejected by the supervisory board.<ref>Carsten Germis, ''Blockade in Wolfsburg verhindert Katrin Suder'', In: [[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung|FAZ]] 6 May 2021.</ref>

==Other activities==
* [[Deutsche Post]], Member of the Supervisory Board (since 2023)<ref>Christoph Schlautmann (24 April 2023), [https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/handel-konsumgueter/ex-mckinsey-beraterin-katrin-suder-soll-deutsche-post-kontrollieren-/29105990.html Ex-McKinsey-Beraterin Katrin Suder soll Deutsche Post kontrollieren ] ''[[Handelsblatt]]''.</ref>
* [[LEG Immobilien]], Member of the Supervisory Board (since 2022)<ref>[https://www.leg-wohnen.de/en/corporation/leg-group/members-of-the-management-and-supervisory-board/dr-katrin-suder Katrin Suder] [[LEG Immobilien]].</ref>
* [[FGS Global]], Senior Advisor (since 2022)<ref>Tanja Kewes (14 June 2022) [https://www.handelsblatt.com/unternehmen/management/berater-neuer-job-fuer-ex-staatssekretaerin-katrin-suder-bei-fgs-global/28423656.html Neuer Job für Ex-Staatssekretärin Katrin Suder bei FGS Global] ''[[Handelsblatt]]''.</ref>
* [[Cloudflare]], Member of the Board of Directors (since 2019)<ref>[https://www.cloudflare.com/de-de/press-releases/2019/cloudflare-announces-new-board-members/ Cloudflare Announces New Board Members] [[Cloudflare]], press release of 29 August 2019.</ref>
* [[Hertie School]], Member of the Board of Trustees (since 2015),<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hertie-school.org/de/news/detail/content/hertie-school-launches-new-degree-programme-master-of-international-affairs/|title=''Hertie School eröffnet neuen Studiengang "Master of International Affairs"'' hertie-school.org, 3 September 2015|access-date=13 October 2021|archive-date=31 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191031203754/https://www.hertie-school.org/de/news/detail/content/hertie-school-launches-new-degree-programme-master-of-international-affairs/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Senior Fellow (since 2018)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hertie-school.org/de/magazin/detail/content/former-defence-state-secretary-katrin-suder-appointed-as-senior-fellow-at-the-hertie-school-of-gover/|title=''Verteidigungsstaatssekretärin a.D. Katrin Suder wird Senior Fellow an der Hertie School of Governance'' hertie-school.org, 26 October 2018|access-date=13 October 2021|archive-date=31 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191031203752/https://www.hertie-school.org/de/magazin/detail/content/former-defence-state-secretary-katrin-suder-appointed-as-senior-fellow-at-the-hertie-school-of-gover/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Suder lives with her partner Katja Kraus, in [[Hamburg]] and has three children.<ref>{{cite web |author= |url=http://www.radiobremen.de/nordwestradio/sendungen/zwei-nach-eins/katrin-suder106.html |title=Katrin Suder – 2 nach 1 |website=www.radiobremen.de |date= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170331210531/http://www.radiobremen.de/nordwestradio/sendungen/zwei-nach-eins/katrin-suder106.html |archive-date=2017-03-31 |url-status=dead |access-date=2017-03-31}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Hamburg|first=Hamburger Abendblatt-|date=2017-03-30|title=Katja Kraus heiratet von der Leyens Staatssekretärin|url=https://www.abendblatt.de/hamburg/article210104397/Katja-Kraus-heiratet-von-der-Leyens-Staatssekretaerin.html|access-date=2021-10-13|website=www.abendblatt.de|language=de-DE}}</ref> At the beginning of March 2017, she and Kraus registered a civil partnership.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-03-29|title=Von der Leyens "beste Frau" - Ex-HSV-Managerin heiratet Freundin|url=https://www.bild.de/politik/inland/katja-kraus/heiratet-katrin-suder-51065562.bild.html|access-date=2021-10-13|website=bild.de|language=de}}</ref>

Suder volunteers for [[Save the Children]]. Until 2015, she was committed to the association Lesbenfrühling e.V.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mitgliederversammlung|url=https://www.savethechildren.de/informieren/ueber-uns/unsere-struktur/mitgliederversammlung/|access-date=2021-10-13|website=Save the Children Deutschland|language=de}}</ref><ref>[https://rp-online.de/politik/katrin-suder-mckinsey-frau-soll-bundeswehr-umbauen_aid-20385615 ''McKinsey-Frau soll Bundeswehr umbauen.''] In: ''rp-online.de''. 26 May 2014, retrieved 11 December 2018.</ref>
